outcome: Cord blood bulky DNA adduct levels
cohort: Pregnant women and their neonates from Greece, Spain, England, Denmark, and Norway, recruited in 2006-2010 (n=511).
finding: Higher bulky DNA adduct levels in neonates were associated with residence in southern European countries, higher maternal BMI, delivery by cesarean section, male infant sex, low maternal fruit intake, high dairy intake, and low adherence to a healthy diet.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was associated with higher bulky DNA adduct levels in neonates.
country: Greece, Spain, England, Denmark, and Norway
